scope: x86-64 four-level paging with 4KiB base pages

claims.claim: Per-process page tables translate virtual to physical addresses and support access control
Linux defines five software paging levels, folds unused levels; x86-64 may run 4- or 5-level translation
TLB hit/miss is translation caching, while page fault requires page table/permissions handling
claims.notes: Diagram is algorithmic, not timing benchmark

claims.claim: Anonymous pages can be demand-zeroed; file-backed or swap faults may need I/O
claims.notes: No invented fault counts or latencies
